mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO recipe_like (recipe_id, user_id) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recipe_like WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO favorite (recipe_id, user_id) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.category_id, r.title, r.cover, r.description, r.views, r.likes_count, r.status, r.reject_reason, r.create_time, r.update_time, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM favorite f JOIN recipe r ON f.recipe_id = r.id JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id JOIN `user` u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.id DESC
